summary: Iteration 3 validated the new AMASS unified-platform modules (Media Library on Emergent object storage, Marketplace, App Configuration, Token Economy). Extended backend tests with a new file /app/backend/tests/test_ext.py containing 32 tests across 7 test classes; combined with the existing 49-test backend_test.py, pytest ran 81/81 PASSED in ~102s. Verified: media upload -> file served WITHOUT auth (correct content-type) -> soft-delete removes from /api/media and returns 404 on file endpoint; marketplace categories (6 seeded)/products (8 seeded, 3 featured) CRUD + PATCH flags; promotions & pricing-rules CRUD; public marketplace endpoints filter status=active and featured=true; app-config returns 6 sections, PUT persists, GET /api/public/app-config returns {key:data} map without auth; tokens: 3 bundles, 3 plans, 3 rewards seeded, 52 wallets, wallet adjustment clamps to 0; public bundles/plans list only active. RBAC: content_manager & finance BOTH return 403 on /api/marketplace/products, /api/app-config, /api/tokens/bundles and /api/media (parametrized). Frontend Playwright: super_admin can login, all 4 Platform pages load (marketplace-page, app-config-page, tokens-page, media-page); mp-tab-products lists 8 products, adding TEST_UI_Product via dialog appears in list and can be deleted; App Config shows 6 tabs with cfg-save-<key> button; Token Economy Bundles tab shows 3 cards, adding TEST_UI_Bundle appears; wallets tab renders; Media Library uploads a 1x1 PNG and it appears with copy-URL. All test data cleaned up.

issues: Radix warning: Missing `Description`/`aria-describedby` for DialogContent (accessibility nit, non-blocking) — same pattern as Properties dialog from iteration 2
Recharts still emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first paint (cosmetic, self-heals) — carried over from previous iterations

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to New-Product / New-Bundle / New-Category / New-Reward / New-Promotion / New-Pricing dialogs to silence Radix warnings.

(Optional hardening) /api/public/marketplace/products currently returns 200 even if the marketplace_config is disabled — consider honoring `marketplace_config.enabled=false` to gate the public endpoint, mirroring the CMS visibility toggle.

(Carryover) Split server.py + modules_ext.py further as new modules land (both now well over the 700 LOC threshold combined; modules_ext.py = 519 LOC and server.py already exceeds 700). Consider a `routers/` package.
critical_code_review_comments: modules_ext.py imports from `server` (api, db, require, get_current_user, log_activity, now_iso, new_id) creating a cross-module circular-import risk if server.py grows further — a shared `deps.py` would make this safer.
media_upload does not validate MIME/size limits — anyone with media.create can upload arbitrary binary of unbounded size to object storage. Add size cap (e.g., 20MB) and allow-list content types.
media_file endpoint is fully public — currently by design, but there is no signed-URL / expiring token option; any leaked storage_path is permanently public. Fine for MVP; note for prod.
_put_object retries only on 403; consider retrying on 401/5xx as well and adding backoff so a transient outage doesn't fail user uploads.

wallet adjustment uses find_one + update_one — not atomic; two concurrent adjustments can race. Use `$inc` with a `max(0, balance+amount)` guard via aggregation pipeline update, or a transaction, for concurrency safety.
MPProduct.status is a free-string ('active' default) — no enum validation; someone could POST status='xyz' and it would be accepted and then filtered out of the public endpoint invisibly.
app_config PUT accepts arbitrary JSON in `data` — no per-key schema validation (e.g., map_settings could get `default_lat='hello'`). Consider Pydantic sub-models per key.
Public token/marketplace endpoints have no rate-limiting — same latent flooding risk as public leads/properties.
